statico.description: Static websites. `futrou deploy` creates each one and uploads its files as a new version, which it activates when something changed.

defaultStatus.description: Status of a default file answer (default 200).

domain.description: Domain name assigned to the resource.

fallbackFile.description: File served for a path that is not found (default /404.html); with fallbackStatus 200 and /index.html it serves a single page app.

htmlToFolders.description: Also copy every page.html as page/index.html (and index.htm as index.html) unless that path exists, so a proxy serves /page (default true).

include.description: The files of the website, as an object whose keys run in order. A key is a file, a folder or a glob (relative to this config file, or absolute; {a,b} and ** work). Its value is true (include: a folder's files land at the root of the website, a file or glob keeps its path relative to this file), a destination in the website ("./" is the root; a folder's files land below it, a file with a name as destination is renamed), or false (exclude what it matches from the files selected so far). Default: the folder of this file at the root. Hidden files and folders (such as .env and .git) and .map files found in a folder or glob are never uploaded; naming one as a source includes it. A _redirects file at the root of the website configures the redirects of the version and is not uploaded.

public.description: Anybody can read the website (default true); false makes it answer only to a request with an API token.

redirects.description: Redirects, in order, before those of a _redirects file.

from.description: Path to match, with :name placeholders and a * splat as in a _redirects file (default: every path). A URL with a host also matches the host.

to.description: Where to redirect to; :name and :splat from the source can be used.
